local_checks.result: build-agent uploads agent-unsigned (release.yml:99-105); sign-agent downloads it by name in the same run (131-134), signs in place via sign-agent.sh (which writes to a mktemp file, verifies, then mv over the target at lines 67-96), and uploads agent-final (170-176); publish-release downloads agent-final (230-234). All handoffs are run-scoped named artifacts with no cross-run or cross-workflow consumption, every checkout uses persist-credentials:false, and publish-release checks out github.ref only for the committed root CA, PKGBUILD and flake (226-250). SHA256SUMS (257) is generated from the same assets it covers and is unsigned, so it offers no integrity independent of the release host; that is a hardening gap, not a substitution path. Immutability of same-run named artifacts is a hosted upload-artifact v7 default not observable here.
